svg.aria-label: Selected work: SSO / IDENTITY PLATFORM (Security & Identity) - Central identity: OAuth2/OIDC, MFA, session governance and audit for the ecosystem.; FOCCOAPI / ERP DATA PLATFORM (Legacy Integration) - Read-only REST + MCP facade over the factory's Oracle ERP. Stable, versioned contracts.; PLATFORM-OPS / CONTROL PLANE (Platform Governance) - The source of truth: sanitized inventory, ADRs, runbooks, evidence, change governance.; PMC / PROJECT PORTFOLIO (Product Delivery) - Corporate project portfolio - scoring matrix, 5W2H plans and formal approval flow.; SGI / INDUSTRIAL KPIs (Data Platforms) - Executive dashboard for industrial KPIs - trends, targets and Excel ingestion.
svg.text: industrial systems for one of brazil's largest furniture manufacturers
Central identity: OAuth2/OIDC, MFA, session governance and audit for the ecosystem.
One login fronting 18 production apps - fail-closed authorization
Read-only REST + MCP facade over the factory's Oracle ERP. Stable, versioned contracts.
Zero writes by invariant - immutable SHA deploys, automatic rollback
The source of truth: sanitized inventory, ADRs, runbooks, evidence, change governance.
92 containers, 28 services, 3 hosts - read-only collectors, SHA-256 evidence
Corporate project portfolio - scoring matrix, 5W2H plans and formal approval flow.
Row-level security on every table - full audit trail - xlsx upsert import
Executive dashboard for industrial KPIs - trends, targets and Excel ingestion.
Behind the central SSO - turns spreadsheet reporting into living dashboards
